items.title: 24.6.1 Acidic and Basic Properties of Amino Acids (amino acids ki acidic aur basic properties) (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Amino acids amphoteric hain, yaani in mein acidic aur basic dono properties hain. Lekin yeh zyada tar carboxylic acids se kam acidic aur zyada tar amines se kam basic hain. Asal mein amino acid molecule (zwitterion) ka acidic hissa –NH₃⁺ group hai, aur basic hissa –COO⁻ group hai, –NH₂ nahi. RNH₃⁺ RCOOH se weak (kamzor) acid hai, jaisa neeche dikhaya gaya hai:

blocks.title: Easy words mein
blocks.text: Pehli equation mein zwitterion ka –NH₃⁺ proton (H⁺) paani ko deta hai: yeh acid ka kaam hai (pKa ≈ 10, yaani weak acid). Doosri equation mein –COO⁻ paani se proton leta hai: yeh base ka kaam hai (pKb ≈ 12, yaani weak base). Kitab pehli line mein ‘not –COO⁻ group’ likhti hai; matlab yeh hai ke acidic hissa –COOH nahi balke –NH₃⁺ hai, kyunke zwitterion mein –COOH pehle hi proton de chuka hota hai.
Paani wale solution mein amino acid ke dipolar ion, cationic (positive) shakal aur anionic (negative) shakal ke beech equilibrium hota hai.

blocks.alt: H3N+-CH(R)-COOH (cationic shakal, kam pH par predominant (zyada)) equilibrium mein, arrows ke oopar OH- aur neeche H+, H3N+-CH(R)-COO- (dipolar ion, isoelectric pH par predominant (zyada)) ke saath, jo isi tarah H2N-CH(R)-COO- (anionic shakal, zyada pH par predominant (zyada)) ke saath equilibrium mein hai.
blocks.caption: Amino acid ki cationic shakal, dipolar ion aur anionic shakal (kitab ke page 130 par chhape diagram ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kam pH (zyada acid) par amino acid cation (H₃N⁺ … COOH) hai. OH⁻ dalne se pehle –COOH ka proton jata hai aur dipolar ion banta hai; aur OH⁻ dalne se –NH₃⁺ ka proton bhi chala jata hai aur anion (H₂N … COO⁻) banta hai. H⁺ dalne se ulta hota hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne dipolar ion ke baad ‘+ OH⁻’ bhi likha hai. OH⁻ yahan banta nahi balke arrow par diya gaya reagent hai, is liye drawing mein use chhor diya gaya hai.

Har amino acid ke liye aik khaas pH hota hai jis par zwitterion ka concentration (miqdar fi hajam) sab se zyada hota hai. Is pH ko isoelectric point (pI) kehte hain, aur har amino acid ka apna alag pI hota hai.

blocks.prompt: Bohat acidic solution mein amino acid kis shakal mein hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Cationic shakal, H₃N⁺–CH(R)–COOH: carboxylate group ne proton le liya hai.

items: Kam pH: cation; pI par: zwitterion; zyada pH: anion.
